variants.title: A · 启程 G
variants.caption: 圆润 G 与前进缺口结合
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Generate ONE original app-icon concept for GraviGo, a third-party MOBILE COMPANION dedicated to Google Antigravity desktop AI coding. Product promise: carry the desktop coding session with you, stay connected and keep moving. Art direction: Google product-icon / Material Design spirit, friendly rounded geometry, clean white full-bleed square background, bold flat filled geometric color blocks, precise optical balance, beautiful crisp edges, simple enough for a 32px launcher icon. Color family: Google blue #4285F4 as lead, green #34A853, yellow #FBBC05 and red #EA4335 as smaller supporting areas; distribute colors with restraint. Make it distinctive and coherent as GraviGo's own mark. Do not reproduce the Google G, Chrome, Drive triangle, Play triangle, Maps pin, Gemini sparkle, or any existing official product logo. No wing or feather symbol required: this is GraviGo, NOT GraviWing. No Klein bottle, infinity/Mobius loop, glass, chrome, glossy 3D, bevels, texture, neon, lighting effects, drop shadows, backgrounds with gradients, mockup phones, lettering, words, watermark, multi-icon sheet or presentation board. ONE unified icon centered in the square. Mark should occupy only CENTRAL 60 percent, ample white margin on EVERY side; thick structural shapes and generous internal gaps. No thin outlines or tiny decorations. Deliver a clean high-quality bitmap, not SVG or an interface screenshot. DESIGN A: a custom blocky rounded G-like open path with an integrated forward-facing opening/arrow cue on its RIGHT side. The geometry should feel like a small journey taking a turn and going forward, with a softly squared silhouette and large white counter. Build the main path from three blue/green/yellow sections, with one short coral-red terminal. Make the open-right corner distinctly offset and forward-swept so it is clearly NOT the existing Google circular G. Strong original structural design, friendly and instantly readable.
